Chain-level campaign-v1 screen (identity_schema campaign-v1, scenario_id null), first run for this chain. Universe built per LINK across all 12 links, worked in priority order: the one money-corner link first (green-methanol-production), then the remaining 4 CHOKE_POINT links (imo-netzero-framework, port-bunkering-licensing-regime, methanol-dual-fuel-engines, methanol-ready-shipyard-capacity), then the rest by chain position.

The mapping (data/mappings/methanol-bunkering.json, 7 issuers, 8 placements across 6 of the chain's 12 links) is status ACTIVE with audit: null (no whole-census fresh-context audit has ever run), so every row on this chain must rest on Ron's 2026-09-01 PLACEMENT-scope rule: audit_scope 'PLACEMENT' declared on the row, admitted when the consumed placement's evidence is entirely VERIFIED, or, since 2026-09-04, when the placement carries a current PASS placement_audits[] entry for that exact (chain_id, link_id, issuer_id) triple. All 8 placements in this mapping carry evidence tagged INFERRED only (zero VERIFIED anywhere), so the tag-alone route admits nothing here; every seated row this run rests on the placement_audits[] route. Atlas ran 6 fresh-context placement audits today (2026-09-14T04:10:00Z): 3 PASS (METHANEX/green-methanol-production, METHANEX/conventional-methanol-production, VOLKSWAGEN/methanol-dual-fuel-engines) and 3 FAIL (KONINKLIJKE-VOPAK/methanol-storage-terminals: role evidence's recorded source_date 2023-07-27 does not match the source's actual 2021-05-11 dateline; WORLD-KINECT/bunker-fuel-physical-supply: role evidence's recorded source_date 2026-04-01 does not match the source's actual 2026-04-05 byline, and the sibling listing identity_evidence date is off by 4 days too; PETROCHINA/bunker-fuel-physical-supply: role evidence's source_excerpt is not a genuine contiguous verbatim span of the cited article, it splices phrases from three separate sentences). 2 further placements (CHEVRON/bunker-fuel-physical-supply, COSCO-SHIPPING-HOLDINGS/shipowner-fleet-commitments) carry no placement_audits[] entry at all and their own evidence is INFERRED, so they are refused on the same PLACEMENT-scope rule with no audit basis to fall back on. This run seats 3 rows (2 issuers, 2 links attributed) and refuses 5 placements across 3 links, documented once per link below rather than repeated.

green-methanol-production [MONEY CORNER, CHOKE_POINT, verdict UNDISCOVERED, impact 88 / crowdedness 20 / capture 88]: SEATED. 1 placement (METHANEX), placement_audits[] PASS (evidence_index 0, 2026-09-14T04:10:00Z). METHANEX carries a COMPLETE O2, T1 profile with the matching placement. Written as the pure_play bucket row under audit_scope PLACEMENT.

conventional-methanol-production [bottleneck MEDIUM, verdict QUIET]: SEATED, as METHANEX's second row on this chain (secondary_link_basis stated, primary row is green-methanol-production). 1 placement (METHANEX), placement_audits[] PASS (evidence_index 0, same audit run). Carries the one earnings nugget verified this run (METHANEX's own world's-largest-supplier self-description, fetched 2026-09-14 from an unrelated 6-K about New Zealand operations, data/edgar/docs/MEOH.json).

methanol-dual-fuel-engines [CHOKE_POINT, verdict UNDISCOVERED, closing-window duopoly]: SEATED. 1 placement (VOLKSWAGEN), placement_audits[] PASS (evidence_index 1, same audit run). VOLKSWAGEN carries a COMPLETE O2, T2 profile with the matching placement. Written as the picks_and_shovels bucket row. No EDGAR document exists for VOW3.DE (Volkswagen AG is a German filer with no SEC registration under this ticker), so earnings_nuggets is empty; the row rests on the placement's own role evidence and the placement audit.

bunker-fuel-physical-supply [bottleneck MEDIUM, verdict QUIET]: searched and refused. 3 placements (WORLD-KINECT, PETROCHINA, CHEVRON), all INFERRED-only evidence. WORLD-KINECT and PETROCHINA each carry a placement_audits[] entry dated today, both FAIL (see above); CHEVRON carries no placement_audits[] entry at all. All three issuers hold COMPLETE O2 profiles on disk (T1, T2, T1 respectively) and would seat immediately once their placement evidence or audit clears; none of their WKC/PCCYF/CVX profile placements array even names this chain's placement yet (each profile's placements[] currently lists only a hormuz-maritime bunker-and-voyage-services entry), a separate profile-sync gap Sieve does not fix by writing a screen row. pure_play.name: Methanex Corporation
pure_play.thesis_1line: The chain's one money-corner link (impact 88, crowdedness 20, capture 88 on the chain's own heat block): through the 27 June 2025 OCI Global acquisition Methanex directly acquired a low-carbon methanol production and marketing business (OCI HyFuels), giving the world's largest methanol producer a controlling position in certified green/low-carbon methanol supply, the layer this chain's own map_limitation calls scarce and logistics-constrained (only ~48 ports worldwide can bunker methanol against 112-plus methanol-capable ships and ~300 more on order). METHANEX also holds a second ACTIVE, placement-audit-PASSED placement on this same chain, conventional-methanol-production (link position 4, verdict QUIET), seated as its own row below with a stated secondary_link_basis rather than folded into this thesis, because the two links score differently (money-corner vs QUIET) and each carries its own link yield. Genuine caveat: Methanex's 2026-09-01 6-K discloses it is idling its four-decade-old New Zealand production facilities from Q1 2027 on declining domestic gas supply, a real capacity headwind on the conventional side that this run found no evidence changes the OCI-derived green/HyFuels position specifically.

theme_revenue_exposure.basis: No methanol-bunkering-specific or green-methanol-specific revenue percentage is disclosed or sourced for Methanex; the company reports methanol production and marketing as a single segment and neither the OCI acquisition 6-K nor the 2026-09-01 New Zealand 6-K breaks out a green/bunker-qualified revenue share. not disclosed.

picks_and_shovels.name: Volkswagen AG
picks_and_shovels.thesis_1line: Volkswagen holds Everllence (renamed from MAN Energy Solutions 4 June 2025), one of exactly two firms designing the two-stroke marine engines every methanol newbuild needs: 210-plus ME-LGIM dual-fuel engines on order or in service and 95 cumulative orders for the methanol-specific G95ME-C10.5-LGIM variant since 2021. The underlying engineering economics are a genuine duopoly (capture would score 60-plus on that basis alone), but the chain's own heat block scores capture down to 45 because Volkswagen agreed 24 June 2026 to sell 51% of Everllence to Bain Capital (targeted close year-end 2026, proceeds ~EUR7.4bn, book value ~EUR3.4bn as of 31 May 2026), moving design-licensing income mostly out of public markets on a live, closing-window basis, while the other duopolist WinGD (wholly owned by China State Shipbuilding Corporation) carries no listed proxy at all. VOW3.DE is a large, liquid, heavily covered stock, but every 2026 headline is about Volkswagen's own group-level crisis, not this angle (crowdedness 20 on the chain's heat block), which is why this specific thesis reads UNDISCOVERED even though the parent ticker is anything but undiscovered.
